name: South West Caregiver Support Fund
summary: One-off cash to help caregivers in the South West District with caregiving costs.
description: It gives a one-off $1,000 to help with self-care and caregiving expenses.

sources.name: South West Community Development Council (South West CDC)

name: Medifund
summary: Medifund helps needy citizens pay medical bills.
description:
Medifund helps needy Singapore citizens who cannot pay their medical bills.

 It can be used to pay for restructured hospitals, national specialty centres, and intermediate and long-term care services.
eligibility: Needy Singapore citizens who are unable to pay for their medical bills. Must be receiving treatment at restructured hospitals, national specialty centres, or intermediate and long-term care services.
